#Module animations

Web Animations (src/page/web_animations.odin): Element.animate, Animation, KeyframeEffect, document.timeline. The browser keeps each animation's state (start time, hold time, playback rate, pending play or pause, play state, replace state) and plays its keyframe effect on the style timeline (src/style/script_anim.odin) like a CSS animation; the engine keeps the JavaScript objects (the KeyframeEffect, the promises) and mirrors what the browser tells it (Animation_takeOps). Times are milliseconds on the document timeline; NaN stands for null (unresolved). "finish", "cancel" and "remove" are fired at the animation (AnimationPlaybackEvent: Event x = currentTime, y = timelineTime, NaN for null).

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/animations.widl.

#Functions

#Animation_create

Animation Animation_create(MicrotaskCallback notify, i32 user)

new Animation(): no effect, on the document timeline. notify(user) runs as a microtask when there is something to take (Animation_takeOps).

Host: Animation_create :: proc(c: ^Call, notify: u32, user: i32) -> u64

#Animation_setEffect

void Animation_setEffect(Animation animation, optional Element target, string keyframes, f64 duration, f64 delay, f64 end_delay, f64 iterations, f64 iteration_start, i32 direction, i32 fill, string easing, i32 composite) raises

Sets the animation's keyframe effect: its target (0: none), its keyframes packed by the engine (offsets computed: keyframes separated by U+001E, fields by U+001F: offset, easing, then property / value pairs), its timing (duration NaN: "auto"; direction and fill as the style engine's enums, fill "auto" as none) and composite operation (0 replace, 1 add, 2 accumulate). Type when an easing does not parse.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Animation_setEffect :: proc(c: ^Call, animation: Api_Animation, target: Api_Element, keyframes: string, duration: f64, delay: f64, end_delay: f64, iterations: f64, iteration_start: f64, direction: i32, fill: i32, easing: string, composite: i32) -> Api_Error

#Animation_takeOps

string Animation_takeOps(Animation animation)

What changed for the engine since the last call, one letter each, in order: r the ready promise is resolved, R it is rejected (AbortError) and replaced by a resolved one, n a new pending ready promise; f the finished promise is resolved, F it is rejected (AbortError) and replaced by a pending one, m a new pending finished promise; k / u the wrapper must be kept alive (the animation may still fire events or show its effect) / may go. Nothing is taken away: Animation_dropOps does once the engine applied them.

Host: Animation_takeOps :: proc(c: ^Call, animation: Api_Animation) -> string
